description: Azure Blob Storage file store (UseAzureBlobStorage) for the CMS framework.
releaseNotes:
v9.3.0: Prefix search, property tab in the URL, CMS search by an item's own text, search rebuild that survives errors

**Changed for search providers of a site's own**
- `SearchRequest` has a new `IncludeReferencedText`: true for public searches, false for CMS searches (`IArkSearchService`). A provider should leave `SearchSchema.ReferencedTextField` out of free-text matching (and highlights) when it is false. The Lucene provider does. Code that only calls the search services needs no change.

**New**
- Search: a word also finds longer words it starts ("contentev" finds "ContentEvent"), in every search through the Lucene provider. Such a match counts half as much as the exact word, so exact matches rank first, and highlights mark the longer word. There is no minimum length: a one-letter word matches every word starting with it.
- CMS: the open property tab is in the URL (`?lang=en&tab=Seo`) on the edit page and the settings page. A link opens the same tab, back and forward step between tabs, and the tabs are real links (open in new tab, copy address). Switching language or version keeps the tab. Switching tabs with unsaved edits doesn't ask to leave the page. `ContentForm` takes optional `tab` and `tabPath` props for this; without them it keeps the open tab itself as before.
- Search: the startup rebuild is a job run. With jobs on, it is a run of `ark-search-reindex` (new trigger `JobTrigger.Startup`, "At startup" in the CMS) with its progress log and outcome, in System > Jobs. New `IArkJobStarter` (Jobs.Abstractions, registered by `UseJobs`) starts a job's run on this instance straight away. Without jobs it is the background rebuild as before.
- Client: the generated types in `@arkframework/cms/client` carry the API's `///` summaries as `/** */` comments, so IntelliSense and the docs site show them.

**Changed**
- Search: a CMS search finds an item by its own text only, not by the text of the content it points to (`[Searchable]` reference properties). Public searches still match that text.
- Search: content with Show in search (`Searchable`) unticked is indexed without referenced text, and what it points to isn't read for it. `IncludeNotSearchable()` finds it by its own text. Items already indexed keep their referenced text until they are next indexed (on save or a rebuild).
- Search: while an index waits for its first full build, the queue worker leaves it to the build instead of replaying into it.
- CMS: the search fields in the rubbish bin, on the search page and in the content picker dialogs are as tall as the other inputs.
- Guide: the Settings section shows `[DisplayText]` on settings properties, which names them in the CMS as on content types.

**Fixed**
- Search: a full rebuild copes with errors. A failed read is tried again (after 1 s, 3 s, 10 s) and the rebuild carries on from where it was. Items that still can't be read are left out, logged and listed in `SearchReindexStatus.Skipped` (`skipped` in `GET /api/search/reindex`) and in the job's log. A database that stays down or a failed index write ends the rebuild as failed, and it isn't started again on its own.

No migrations.
